title: ErasureProof
description: What one service erased for a request, and what it kept and why. No raw subject identifiers are stored here; digests let an authorised caller confirm a known subject and prevent stale HR data from returning.

pseudonym.description: What the person's identifiers were replaced with.

counts.description: Rows changed per data location, for example entries.contributor.

hrFenceKeys.description: Control-plane erasure fence keys: tenant-scoped, namespaced one-way digests of known aliases and HR keys, retained with the erasure/idempotency proof. No raw email or HR key.

subjectDigest.description: SHA-256 (hex) over the tenant id and the sorted identifiers.
